description.en: Rate your interest in 60 concrete work tasks. Six separate raw readings and complete free guides; an original supplement to the core RIASEC test.
description.zh: 为60项具体工作任务评兴趣，分别阅读六组原始均分与完整免费指南。作为核心RIASEC的原创补充，不评能力、职业匹配或资格。

resultHeading.en: Six separate task-interest readings and full guides
resultHeading.zh: 六组独立任务兴趣读法与完整指南

introduction.en: Would you enjoy doing the activity itself? Explore sixty concrete tasks, from repairing a practice object to checking a sample record. Six separate readings help you choose what to investigate next. This original supplement leaves the full core RIASEC assessment as the main route for a broader interest profile.
introduction.zh: 你是否喜欢做这件事本身？从修补练习物件到核对示例记录，用六十项具体任务探索兴趣。六组独立读法帮助选择下一步了解的活动；这份原创补充保留完整核心RIASEC，作为了解更广兴趣轮廓的主入口。

instructions.en: Imagine reasonable training, tools and support are available. Rate how much you would like doing each activity itself, not how skilled you are, its pay or status, or whether you can currently enter that work. Use 1 Strongly dislike through 5 Strongly like; 3 is a valid neutral response. Choose Cannot judge / too unfamiliar when you cannot form a view. Respond to all 60 prompts. Each ten-task group needs eight numeric ratings for its own mean. No timer, total, ranking, top-three code or job match is produced. The estimated 12 minutes covers ratings and instructions, not reading all six long guides.
instructions.zh: 设想有合理培训、工具和支持。评自己是否想做这项活动本身，不评现有技能、薪资地位或眼下能否入行。从1很不喜欢到5很喜欢，3是有效中立回答；无法形成看法时选暂无法判断／太陌生。全部60项均需回应，每组十项至少八条数字才显示所属均分。没有计时、总分、排名、前三代码或职业匹配。约12分钟是说明与作答的编辑估计，不包含读完六篇长指南。

title.en: Hands-on and physical tasks | Work Activity Interests
title.zh: 动手与实体操作｜工作活动兴趣

description.zh: 具体任务兴趣的免费完整指南：例子、小探索、原始和与均分、缺失项及边界。不生成能力或职业适配分数。

title.en: Interest in doing something tangible
title.zh: 对实体操作本身的兴趣

paragraphs.en: This group asks about the activity of working with physical objects, materials, plants, tools and a site. Its ten tasks include repairing a practice tube, fitting labeled pipe sections, measuring foam, checking a cart and caring for measuring tools. Read your answer as willingness to try these particular activities under reasonable training and support. It is not a test of dexterity, strength, technical knowledge or how quickly you could complete a repair.
paragraphs.zh: 这组询问处理实体物件、材料、植物、工具与场地的活动兴趣。十项包括修补练习内胎、连接标号管段、测量泡沫板、检查推车和维护量具。回答表示在有合理培训与支持时，是否愿意尝试这些具体活动，不测试手巧、力量、技术知识或维修速度。

paragraphs.en: The letter R is a familiar organizing cue, not a certified Realistic score. These newly written tasks have not inherited the properties of a published inventory. Enjoying a carefully supervised workshop also need not mean enjoying every outdoor, mechanical or industrial job. The material, setting, pace and safety arrangements can change what you want to do.
paragraphs.zh: 字母R只作熟悉的整理线索，不是经认证的实作型分数。新写任务不会继承已发表问卷的测量性质。喜欢有人指导的工坊，也不等于喜欢所有户外、机械或工业工作；材料、场地、节奏和安全安排都可能改变意愿。

title.en: A repair task from start to finish
title.zh: 从头到尾看一项修补任务

paragraphs.en: Imagine receiving a practice object, checking the brief, choosing a tool, trying a repair and inspecting the result. Which stage seems appealing: handling the material, making an adjustment or seeing a tangible change? Those details give more information than a general claim that you are practical. You can enjoy the handling stage while disliking repeated setup or cleanup. The ten ratings do not record those reasons separately.
paragraphs.zh: 设想收到练习物件后，核对要求、选择工具、尝试修补，再检查结果。吸引你的是接触材料、动手调整，还是看见实体变化？这些细节比“我很务实”的概括更具体。可以喜欢操作阶段，却不喜欢反复准备或清理；十项评分没有分别记录这些原因。

paragraphs.en: A low rating can concern the chosen object rather than physical work as a whole. For example, someone may welcome planting tasks but avoid textile repair. Look back at the individual task descriptions privately before treating their average as one preference. A wide range within the group is useful context, even though this version displays only its raw summary.
paragraphs.zh: 较低评分可能只针对特定物件，而非全部实体工作。例如愿意种植，却不想修补布料。把平均数当成一种偏好前，可私下回看各任务。组内差异本身是有用背景，虽然本版只显示原始汇总。

title.en: Training and access are separate questions
title.zh: 培训与可接触机会分别考虑

paragraphs.en: Someone can be interested without having used the tools before. Someone with years of experience can also be tired of an activity. This questionnaire asks neither for proof of experience nor for a demonstration of safe technique. If you cannot imagine the activity clearly enough, use the unscored option rather than converting unfamiliarity into dislike. A neutral response instead means you can form a view and feel neither like nor dislike.
paragraphs.zh: 没有用过工具，也可以感兴趣；做了多年，也可能已经厌倦。问卷不索要经验凭证，也不演示安全技术。如果无法清楚想象活动，可选未评分，不必把陌生写成不喜欢。中立则表示能形成看法，但既不喜欢也不讨厌。

paragraphs.en: Physical access, fatigue, equipment and a suitable learning environment can matter greatly in a real decision. None is inferred from the number. An accommodation may change the experience without changing the purpose of the activity. Do not use this reading to decide another person’s suitability or to replace a qualified assessment of a hazardous task.
paragraphs.zh: 真实选择还需考虑身体可及性、疲劳、设备和合适的学习环境，数字不推断这些条件。合理调整可能改变体验而保留活动目的。不能用这份读法决定他人的适任性，也不能替代危险任务的合格评估。

title.en: Distinguish making, investigating and creating
title.zh: 区分制作、调查与创作

paragraphs.en: Working on one object may involve several interests. Tightening a cart wheel emphasizes changing a physical object; tracing why it repeatedly loosens emphasizes investigation; designing how the cart should look emphasizes creation. These are ways to examine what draws your attention, not exclusive occupational categories. An actual role may ask for all three, along with records, coordination and explaining a process to someone else.
paragraphs.zh: 同一物件可以涉及多种兴趣。紧固推车轮子侧重实体调整；追查反复松动的原因侧重调查；设计推车外观侧重创作。这些角度帮助看清关注点，不是互斥职业类别。一份真实工作可能同时要求三者，以及记录、协调和向他人讲解。

paragraphs.en: Read the six groups in their fixed display order. Their tasks differ in content, so even equal means do not establish equal underlying traits. There is no top group, three-letter code or automatic list of careers here. To explore a broader interest profile, use the linked core RIASEC route and keep its separate form and interpretation visible.
paragraphs.zh: 按固定顺序分别看六组。各组题材不同，即使均分相同，也不证明潜在特质相等。本版没有最高组、三字母代码或自动职业清单。更广的兴趣轮廓可从所链核心RIASEC入口了解，并保留那套独立题本与解释。

title.en: A small, safe observation
title.zh: 做一次小而安全的观察

paragraphs.en: Choose one low-risk task you can observe or try with suitable instruction, such as assembling a harmless model from labeled parts. Before starting, write what you expect to enjoy. Afterwards, note which stage held your attention, what became tiring and what support changed the experience. A brief trial is information about that occasion, not evidence that you should enter a trade or leave your current work.
paragraphs.zh: 可以挑一项有合适指导、低风险的活动观察或尝试，例如按标号组装无害模型。开始前写下预计喜欢什么；结束后记下哪个阶段吸引注意、哪里疲倦，以及支持如何改变体验。短暂尝试只提供这次的信息，不证明应该入某行业或离开现职。

paragraphs.en: You may instead read a task description or ask someone what a typical workday involves. Include setup, waiting, checking and cleanup rather than considering only the satisfying final result. Keep interest, observed skill, safety requirements and practical access in separate notes. No score increase is required, and deciding not to try is an acceptable outcome of exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 也可阅读任务说明，或询问从业者典型一天的内容。除满意的最终成果，也了解准备、等待、核查与清理。分别记录兴趣、观察到的技能、安全要求与实际可接触条件。无需提高分数；决定暂不尝试，也是探索的合理结果。

title.en: Read the raw numbers with their coverage
title.zh: 结合覆盖度读原始数字

paragraphs.en: Each group has ten activities with the same 1–5 interest anchors and no reverse items. All sixty prompts need a response before a result appears; the unscored option counts as a response but not a rating. A group needs at least eight numeric ratings for a displayed mean. For example, ratings 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5 and two unscored responses give sum 27, eight ratings and displayed mean 3.4. Seven ratings keep that group insufficient, regardless of their values.
paragraphs.zh: 每组十项，使用相同1—5兴趣锚点，没有反向题。结果出现前需回应全部六十项；未评分算回应，不算数字评分。每组至少八条数字才显示均分。例如1、2、3、3、4、4、5、5与两条未评分，原始和27、有效八条、显示均分3.4；只有七条有效时，无论数字多高均保留资料不足。

paragraphs.en: The original sum and rated count remain visible beside the mean, rounded to one decimal. Missing ratings are not zero and are not made neutral. The minimum-eight rule is a website coverage convention, not a validated threshold. A higher mean records more liking for the rated tasks in this set; a lower mean records less. Different answers, including strongly mixed ones, can yield the same average. No total, percentile, level or prediction follows from it.
paragraphs.zh: 原始和与有效项数和均分一起保留，均分显示一位小数。缺失不补零或中立。至少八项是本站覆盖约定，不是经验证阈值。较高均分表示更喜欢本组已评任务，较低表示较少喜欢。不同回答、包括强烈分化的组合，可以得到同一均分；不生成总分、百分位、等级或预测。

title.en: Version, privacy and your next choice
title.zh: 版本、隐私与下一步选择

paragraphs.en: FermatMind independently wrote this sixty-task bank and its English and Chinese text. Reliability, validity, norms and cross-language measurement equivalence have not been established. It does not reproduce an official O*NET Interest Profiler form or inherit the evidence for a published instrument. The official profiler and the FermatMind core RIASEC forms are distinct products. Keep this supplement’s version and task wording with any private notes rather than treating familiar letters as proof of identical measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 这套六十项任务及英中文由费马独立编写，尚未建立信度、效度、常模或跨语言测量等值。不复现官方O*NET兴趣问卷题本，也不继承已发表工具的证据。官方问卷与费马核心RIASEC题本是不同产品。私人笔记宜保留补充版版本与任务原文，不把熟悉字母当作相同测量的证明。

paragraphs.en: All six complete guides are public before any answers and remain the same for every response pattern, including all unscored. Answers are calculated on this page. Only an explicit choice saves a tab draft for up to 24 hours; completion, retake or exit-and-clear removes it. Sharing copies only the public title and entry link, without ratings or means. You can stop, read another guide or visit the core assessment without transferring answers. No payment, registration or desired score is required for these guides.

title.en: Interest in a question and its evidence

paragraphs.en: This group concerns investigating a question, comparing explanations and checking evidence. Its ten tasks include reviewing sensor tables, planning a small experiment, tracing an unusual reading and checking whether a chart supports a claim. Rate whether you would like the activity of finding out, with reasonable preparation available. The result does not establish scientific knowledge, mathematical ability, intelligence or the quality of a conclusion you might reach.
paragraphs.zh: 这组关注调查问题、比较解释和核查证据。十项包括查看传感器数据表、计划小实验、回查异常读数，以及判断图表是否支持主张。有合理准备条件时，评自己是否想做弄清问题的活动。结果不确定科学知识、数学能力、智力或结论质量。

paragraphs.en: I is an organizing label for this original task set, not a validated Investigative scale. Some tasks use numbers, some images and some written reasoning. Liking one format does not imply liking them all. You may enjoy a question intensely while finding the repeated measurements or documentation required to answer it less appealing. Those distinctions deserve attention beyond an average.

title.en: Follow an unexpected reading

paragraphs.en: Imagine a simple classroom instrument produces one surprising value. You could check the recording steps, repeat the measurement and compare alternative explanations. Ask which part attracts you: the puzzle, careful repetition, a visual pattern or explaining uncertainty. You are not required to choose the correct explanation here. These are interest ratings, so neither a plausible hypothesis nor an error changes the numerical scoring rule.
paragraphs.zh: 设想一个简单课堂仪器给出意外数值。可以检查记录步骤、重复测量并比较解释。吸引你的是谜题、仔细重复、视觉规律，还是解释不确定性？这里无需选出正确原因。它评兴趣，因此猜想是否合理或出现错误都不改变计分规则。

paragraphs.en: Someone may dislike laboratory materials but enjoy checking a written argument. Another person may prefer hands-on measurements to reading summaries. A lower mean might reflect the topics or formats you imagined rather than a general wish to avoid inquiry.

title.en: Separate curiosity from performance

paragraphs.en: A person can want to learn an unfamiliar method and still need substantial teaching. A trained specialist can perform a method well while wishing to spend less time on it. A numeric midpoint is instead a neutral view of the activity.

paragraphs.en: Real research also depends on sound methods, permission to use data, equipment and supervision. Interest alone supplies none of those conditions. This guide does not authorize an experiment involving people, hazardous materials or private records. For exploration, use safe teaching examples and public or fictional information. No inference about education, employability or suitability for scientific training follows from a mean.

paragraphs.en: Checking an invoice against an order emphasizes following a stated record rule. Investigating why discrepancies keep appearing emphasizes an explanatory question. Creating a more expressive way to present the findings emphasizes design. These activities can occur together, and none requires an exclusive interest identity. paragraphs.en: Pick a safe, small question using public or fictional information, such as why two sample charts appear different. Write two explanations before checking axes, units and source notes. paragraphs.en: This group concerns explaining, listening, guiding and adapting support for another person. Its ten tasks include showing a registration process, teaching a spreadsheet operation, clarifying a service request and offering specific feedback. Rate whether you would like participating in those activities with reasonable preparation. The result does not establish empathy, kindness, teaching skill, clinical competence or how another person experiences your help.

A person can prefer quiet one-to-one teaching and dislike busy group settings. Someone else may enjoy a workshop but prefer not to offer individual guidance. The selected tasks cannot resolve every setting-specific difference.

paragraphs.en: Imagine a newcomer asks how to register for an event. You could ask which step is unclear, show it at a suitable pace and check whether the explanation helped. Which part sounds appealing: listening, explaining, adapting or seeing someone become more independent? Your interest rating does not show whether you would actually do these things well or whether the person wanted that form of assistance.
paragraphs.zh: 设想新来者询问怎样报名活动。可以先问哪里不清楚，以适当节奏示范，再了解解释是否有帮助。吸引你的是倾听、说明、调整，还是看见对方更独立？兴趣评分不能表明是否真的做得好，也不能确定对方是否希望以这种方式获助。

paragraphs.zh: 全部六篇完整指南在作答前公开，所有回答模式、包括全部未评分，读到相同正文。回答在本页计算；只有主动选择才保存最多24小时的标签页草稿，完成、重测或退出清除时删除。分享只复制公开标题与入口，不含评分或均分。可停止、读其他指南或访问核心入口，答案不会转移。阅读无需付款、注册或达到某个分数。

title.zh: 记录与整理：完整兴趣指南

summary.zh: 通过具体例子、私人小尝试、原始均分算例与明确边界，探索记录与整理兴趣。

scoreReading.en: Liking for this selected task set, read with rated coverage; no ability, rank or job match.
scoreReading.zh: 结合有效覆盖度阅读对所选任务的喜欢程度，不评能力、排名或职业匹配。

title.en: Records and organizing tasks | Work Activity Interests
title.zh: 记录与整理｜工作活动兴趣

description.en: Complete free guide to concrete task interests: examples, a small exploration, raw sums and means, missing ratings and limits. No ability or job-fit score.
description.zh: 具体任务兴趣的免费完整指南：例子、小探索、原始和与均分、缺失项及边界。不生成能力或职业适配分数。

title.en: Interest in making information usable
title.zh: 对整理出可用信息的兴趣

paragraphs.en: This group concerns recording, checking, categorizing and maintaining information under stated rules. Its ten tasks include reconciling identifiers, checking a booking schedule, updating an index and reviewing date formats. Rate whether you would like doing those concrete activities with reasonable training and tools. A mean does not establish accuracy, conscientiousness, reliability, mathematical skill or how well you would perform under a real organization’s procedures.
paragraphs.zh: 这组关注按明确规则记录、核查、归类和维护信息。十项包括核对编号、检查预约表、更新索引和统一日期格式。有合理培训与工具时，评是否喜欢做这些具体活动。均分不确定准确性、尽责、可靠性、数学技能或执行真实机构流程的表现。

paragraphs.en: C is an organizing cue for this original bank, not a validated Conventional score. Interest in clear records does not imply preferring tradition in politics or having a rigid personality. The tasks concern particular information processes. Someone may enjoy resolving inconsistencies but dislike prolonged data entry, while another person enjoys a predictable routine more than investigating an unusual discrepancy.
paragraphs.zh: C是本原创题本的整理线索，不是经验证的常规型分数。喜欢清楚记录不意味着政治上偏传统或人格僵化。任务针对具体信息过程。有人喜欢解决不一致，却不喜欢长时间录入；也有人喜欢可预期的常规，胜过调查异常差异。

title.en: Follow one record through its changes
title.zh: 跟随一条记录的变化

paragraphs.en: Imagine a fictional project notice receives a new version. You update the index, record who received it and check that the naming rule is followed. Which part appeals: a clear procedure, finding a discrepancy, finishing a consistent set or making information easier for others to use? The average does not record those motives. It also does not check whether your completed log would be correct.
paragraphs.zh: 设想虚构项目通知更新版本。需要更新索引、记录发给谁，并检查命名规范。吸引你的是清楚流程、找出差异、完成一致的记录集，还是方便他人使用？均分不记录这些动机，也不检查最终日志是否正确。

paragraphs.en: A low rating can concern repetitive screen work or the imagined setting rather than an inability to organize. A high rating may reflect satisfaction with a short puzzle rather than enthusiasm for a long routine. Look at the activity and the conditions you supplied. Real record work can include interruptions, exceptions and accountability that a brief prompt does not capture.
paragraphs.zh: 较低评分可能涉及重复屏幕操作或想象场合，而非不会整理；较高评分也可能喜欢短谜题，而非长时间常规事务。注意活动和自己补入的条件。真实记录工作还有打断、例外和问责，简短题目无法涵盖。

title.en: Separate liking a system from doing it accurately
title.zh: 把喜欢系统与准确执行分开

paragraphs.en: You can enjoy organizing while still making errors or needing instruction. You can also perform a routine accurately while wishing to do less of it. This is an interest reflection, not a timed accuracy task or a test of diligence. Choose unscored if the task is too unfamiliar to judge. A neutral rating means neither like nor dislike and is included in the raw mean.
paragraphs.zh: 喜欢整理，也可能出错或需要指导；准确执行常规事务，也可能希望少做一些。这是兴趣反思，不是计时准确率任务或勤勉测试。陌生到无法判断时选未评分；中立表示既不喜欢也不讨厌，计入原始均分。

paragraphs.en: Real information work may involve privacy, permissions, retention rules and consequences for an incorrect record. A high score provides none of the required authority or training. Explore using fictional or properly public sample data, and do not enter another person’s records into this questionnaire. It cannot certify readiness for bookkeeping, compliance, administration or any role with a controlled information boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 真实信息工作可能涉及隐私、权限、保留规则和错误记录的后果。高分不提供所需权限或培训。探索时使用虚构或适当公开的示例资料，不把他人记录输入问卷。它不能认证记账、合规、行政或任何受控信息职责的任职准备。

title.en: Rules, explanation and invention can share a project
title.zh: 规则、解释与创意可以共存

paragraphs.en: Following a naming convention emphasizes a stated information rule. Asking why the rule keeps failing adds investigation; redesigning a clearer document layout adds creation; teaching the process adds support. A real project can require all these activities. The letters are a way to keep selected prompts organized, not a claim that a person or a job belongs in only one category.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循命名规范侧重明确的信息规则；追问规则为何失效涉及调查；重新设计更清楚的版式涉及创作；教授流程涉及支持。真实项目可以同时需要这些活动。字母用于整理所选题目，不表示一个人或岗位只能归入一类。

paragraphs.en: All six means are displayed in a fixed order without ranks, thresholds or a three-letter interest code. They summarize different tasks, so comparing their numbers cannot establish a validated preference hierarchy. For a broader interest profile, use the core RIASEC link and read its own form-specific explanation. The supplement neither supplies its scores nor produces an occupation match from these task ratings.
paragraphs.zh: 六项均分固定顺序显示，不排名、不分档、不生成三字母兴趣代码。各组任务不同，数字比较不能建立经验证的偏好层级。更广轮廓可从核心RIASEC链接了解，并阅读其题本解释；补充盘点不提供核心分数，也不从任务评分生成职业匹配。

title.en: Try a small fictional record set
title.zh: 试一组小型虚构记录

paragraphs.en: Create a few fictional appointment rows with one missing field and two inconsistent dates. Apply a clear rule, record the exceptions and check the final set. Afterwards, note whether you enjoyed the routine, discovering errors or making the information easier to retrieve. Interest and correctness should be separate observations. You do not need to time the exercise, compete with someone or produce a perfect result.
paragraphs.zh: 可做几条虚构预约记录，放入一个缺失字段和两个不一致日期。按清楚规则处理、记录例外并检查最终记录。之后记下是否喜欢常规过程、发现错误或改善检索。兴趣与正确性分别观察，无需计时、竞争或做到完美。

paragraphs.en: Ask what a longer version would involve: volume, interruptions, unclear cases and responsibility for corrections. A short task can feel satisfying while a full day feels different. If you cannot try it, read a public process description and keep the reaction tentative. You may want more variety, different tools or less screen time; those conditions provide useful context without turning a mean into a personality verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 也问更长版本会涉及什么：数量、打断、模糊情形和纠错责任。短任务令人满足，整天做可能不同。不能尝试时，可阅读公开流程说明并保留暂定看法。可能希望更多变化、不同工具或更少屏幕时间；这些背景比人格判定更有用。

title.en: Read the raw numbers with their coverage
title.zh: 结合覆盖度读原始数字

paragraphs.en: Each group has ten activities with the same 1–5 interest anchors and no reverse items. All sixty prompts need a response before a result appears; the unscored option counts as a response but not a rating. A group needs at least eight numeric ratings for a displayed mean. For example, ratings 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5 and two unscored responses give sum 27, eight ratings and displayed mean 3.4. Seven ratings keep that group insufficient, regardless of their values.
paragraphs.zh: 每组十项，使用相同1—5兴趣锚点，没有反向题。结果出现前需回应全部六十项；未评分算回应，不算数字评分。每组至少八条数字才显示均分。例如1、2、3、3、4、4、5、5与两条未评分，原始和27、有效八条、显示均分3.4；只有七条有效时，无论数字多高均保留资料不足。

paragraphs.en: The original sum and rated count remain visible beside the mean, rounded to one decimal. Missing ratings are not zero and are not made neutral. The minimum-eight rule is a website coverage convention, not a validated threshold. A higher mean records more liking for the rated tasks in this set; a lower mean records less. Different answers, including strongly mixed ones, can yield the same average. No total, percentile, level or prediction follows from it.
paragraphs.zh: 原始和与有效项数和均分一起保留，均分显示一位小数。缺失不补零或中立。至少八项是本站覆盖约定，不是经验证阈值。较高均分表示更喜欢本组已评任务，较低表示较少喜欢。不同回答、包括强烈分化的组合，可以得到同一均分；不生成总分、百分位、等级或预测。

title.en: Version, privacy and your next choice
title.zh: 版本、隐私与下一步选择

paragraphs.en: FermatMind independently wrote this sixty-task bank and its English and Chinese text. Reliability, validity, norms and cross-language measurement equivalence have not been established. It does not reproduce an official O*NET Interest Profiler form or inherit the evidence for a published instrument. The official profiler and the FermatMind core RIASEC forms are distinct products. Keep this supplement’s version and task wording with any private notes rather than treating familiar letters as proof of identical measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 这套六十项任务及英中文由费马独立编写，尚未建立信度、效度、常模或跨语言测量等值。不复现官方O*NET兴趣问卷题本，也不继承已发表工具的证据。官方问卷与费马核心RIASEC题本是不同产品。私人笔记宜保留补充版版本与任务原文，不把熟悉字母当作相同测量的证明。

paragraphs.en: All six complete guides are public before any answers and remain the same for every response pattern, including all unscored. Answers are calculated on this page. Only an explicit choice saves a tab draft for up to 24 hours; completion, retake or exit-and-clear removes it. Sharing copies only the public title and entry link, without ratings or means. You can stop, read another guide or visit the core assessment without transferring answers. No payment, registration or desired score is required for these guides.
paragraphs.zh: 全部六篇完整指南在作答前公开，所有回答模式、包括全部未评分，读到相同正文。回答在本页计算；只有主动选择才保存最多24小时的标签页草稿，完成、重测或退出清除时删除。分享只复制公开标题与入口，不含评分或均分。可停止、读其他指南或访问核心入口，答案不会转移。阅读无需付款、注册或达到某个分数。

title.en: An original concrete-task supplement
title.zh: 原创具体任务补充

paragraphs.en: Sixty newly written activities cover six familiar work-interest areas: hands-on, investigation, creation, support, initiative and organizing. The six descriptive readings are separate. The full core RIASEC assessment remains the main route for a broader profile; this supplement adds a different, literal task perspective without replacing its forms or scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 六十项新写活动涉及六个熟悉工作兴趣领域：动手、调查、创作、支持、推动与整理，分别给出描述性读法。完整核心RIASEC仍是更广兴趣轮廓的主入口；补充盘点增加字面任务视角，不替换核心题本或计分。

title.en: Rate the activity, not your current skill
title.zh: 评活动兴趣，不评现有技能

paragraphs.en: Imagine reasonable training, tools and support. Rate whether you would like doing the activity itself, leaving pay, prestige and current access aside. Neutral is numeric 3. Too unfamiliar to judge remains unscored. Each ten-task group needs eight numeric ratings; there is no timer, total, ranking, top-three code or occupation match. The 12-minute estimate is for instructions and ratings, excluding the six long guides.
paragraphs.zh: 设想有合理培训、工具和支持。评是否愿意做活动本身，暂放薪资、声望和当前入行条件。中立是数字3；陌生到无法判断则保留未评分。每组十项至少八条数字，无计时、总分、排名、前三代码或职业匹配。12分钟估计只含说明与评分，不含六篇长指南。

title.en: Keep different instruments distinct
title.zh: 区分不同题本身份

paragraphs.en: This is a FermatMind original bank, not the official O*NET Interest Profiler, a translation of its questions or a named validated scale. The shared six-area vocabulary does not make item content, scores or evidence interchangeable. English and Chinese are newly authored working versions without established reliability, validity, norms or measurement equivalence. The official source below describes its own separate tool, not validation of this supplement.
paragraphs.zh: 这是费马原创题本，不是官方O*NET兴趣问卷、其题目译本或具名已验证量表。共享六领域词汇，不使题文、分数或证据可互换。英中文均为新写工作版本，未建立信度、效度、常模或测量等值。下方官方来源说明其自身工具，不是补充版验证。

title.en: Private answers, public complete guides
title.zh: 私人回答与完整公开指南

paragraphs.en: All six guides can be read before answering and never depend on a score. Answers stay in this page; only your explicit choice saves a tab draft for up to 24 hours. Completion, retake or exit-and-clear removes it. No response sheet or mean is uploaded or added to a URL. Ordinary route analytics are disabled; optional anonymous activity counting requires its separate explicit opt-in. Sharing copies only the public title and entry link.
paragraphs.zh: 六篇指南均可先读，不依赖分数。回答保留在本页，只有主动选择才保存最多24小时标签页草稿；完成、重测或退出清除时删除。不上传答卷或均分，不加入网址。普通路由分析关闭；可选匿名活动计数需要另行主动选择。分享只复制公开标题和入口。

question.en: Is this the official O*NET Interest Profiler?

answer.en: No. FermatMind independently authored these sixty tasks and bilingual guides. It is not an official form, translated item set or validated substitute. Familiar six-area labels do not make scores interchangeable.
answer.zh: 不是。费马独立编写六十项任务与双语指南，不是官方题本、原题译本或经验证替代版。熟悉的六领域标签不使分数可互换。

question.en: How does this relate to the core RIASEC assessment?

answer.en: The complete core RIASEC remains the main route for a broader interest profile. This separate supplement asks about concrete activities. It does not alter core scoring, transfer answers or supply its top-three code.
answer.zh: 完整核心RIASEC仍是更广兴趣轮廓的主入口。本补充独立询问具体活动，不改核心计分、不传答案，也不提供核心前三代码。

answer.en: Use Cannot judge / too unfamiliar. It counts as a response, not a numeric rating. Each ten-task group needs eight numeric ratings for a mean; otherwise it shows insufficient information. All guides remain free.
answer.zh: 选暂无法判断／太陌生。它算回应，不算数字评分。每组十项至少八条数字才有均分，否则显示资料不足；全部指南仍免费。

question.en: Does a high mean mean skill or a suitable career?
question.zh: 高均分表示擅长或适合某职业吗？

answer.en: No. It describes liking for the rated tasks in one selected set. It establishes no ability, qualification, personality rank, hiring recommendation, population standing or career fit.
answer.zh: 不表示。它描述对一组选定已评任务的喜欢，不确定能力、资格、人格排名、招聘建议、人群位置或职业适配。

question.en: Are my ratings included in sharing?

answer.en: No. Sharing copies only the public title and entry link. All six guides are general, identical for everyone and available without answering. A tab draft exists only if you explicitly choose to save it.
answer.zh: 不包含。只复制公开标题和入口。六篇指南为人人相同的通用正文，不作答也能阅读；只有明确主动保存才有标签页草稿。
